summary: On June 12, 2026, Trinity Biotech plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with Lucid Capital Markets, LLC to sell up to $4.35 million of American Depositary Shares (each representing 20 A Ordinary Shares). The company also terminated a prior ATM agreement with Craig-Hallum, which had been inactive since March 2025. Under the new ATM, Lucid will receive a 3% commission. Sales will be made under an existing effective shelf registration statement. This is an ordinary equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. The filing also includes the legal opinion and termination notice. No extraordinary transaction, activist, or structural change is involved.
